name: Moonrise
summary: A riverside city that follows the clock: roll the sun and moon and watch the windows light up
about: A city skyline by a river, with a bridge, a passing train and a little boat, drawn so that everything follows the time of day. Roll the sun and moon across the sky and the colours shift through golden hour, sunset and night while hundreds of windows switch on in waves, people appear at them, streetlamps flicker on and the river fills with reflections; cross midnight and fireworks burst over the water. Good for a hotel or city guide, a time zone page or a calm night-mode hero.
how: Drag the sky sideways, or use the time slider (arrow keys work), to move through the day.
Windows light up one by one at dusk and go dark through the night; tap any window to switch its light yourself.
Scroll past midnight for fireworks over the river; mornings bring birds, nights bring shooting stars.
Press Play the night to run the clock fast, or Right now to glide to your own time.
With reduced motion there is no twinkling or flickering and the lights switch without fading.
